items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: That was Kimball, and it was... Manuel Perez.

ctx.x: This is your brother here, the tall... That's right. He was rather tall, about your height, would you say? Just about my height.
Yeah, he was about six foot, six foot two, six foot three, like that. That was Kimball, and it was... Manuel Perez.
Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez.
